perfume.answer: Virgin Australia permits perfumes, hair spray, deodorant and hand sanitiser in carry-on or checked baggage, up to 0.5 kg or 0.5 L per article and 2 kg or 2 L in total.

sections.h: 🧴 What Virgin Australia says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the Virgin Australia Dangerous goods page, section "Toiletry and medicinal articles", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Virgin Australia rule
rows: Aerosols such as hair spray and deodorant, flammable liquids such as hand sanitiser, perfumes and medicines containing alcohol
No more than 0.5 kg or 0.5 L
No more than 2 kg or 2 L, including non-flammable aerosols for sporting or home use
Protected by a cap or other suitable means
Personal use only; the aerosol must have no other hazard
Liquid, aerosol and gel limits apply in carry-on

list: Not on the page: the page does not repeat the 100 ml container figure; it refers to the Department of Infrastructure.

faq: Can I take perfume on Virgin Australia?
Yes, in carry-on or checked baggage: each article up to 0.5 kg or 0.5 L, and all toiletry and medicinal articles up to 2 kg or 2 L in total.
Is hand sanitiser allowed on Virgin Australia?
Yes. The Dangerous goods page lists flammable liquids such as hand sanitiser among the permitted toiletry and medicinal articles, within the same limits.
